key_insight: SP-HQAOA combines hierarchical decomposition with symmetry-preserving contraction to optimize problems larger than a quantum device’s qubit limit using shallow circuits.
engineering_relevance: Leaf subproblems can exceed the per-call qubit budget while every quantum circuit remains within that budget.
method: Recursively divide and merge optimization subproblems.
Contract parity sectors while preserving the zero-field Ising objective structure.
Bound potential optimal-value loss from sector restrictions and sum bounds across the hierarchy.
evidence_signal: At depth p=1, the abstract reports 99.4–99.7% of the exact optimum on N=40 random regular MaxCut leaf blocks and 96% of a classical reference for N=500 using at most 10 qubits per circuit.
watch_item: Sector restrictions can sacrifice solution quality; these benchmarks alone do not establish practical quantum advantage.
paper_title: Symmetry-Preserving Hierarchical Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm with Subproblems Beyond the Qubit Limit
